description: This file defines a PHP trait 'WorkWeekServiceTrait' within the OrangeHRM project, providing a method to access the WorkWeekService from a service container. It is part of the Leave module's service layer, specifically a trait that can be included in classes to utilize the WorkWeekService.

methods.name: getWorkWeekService
methods.description: Returns an instance of WorkWeekService by retrieving it from the service container.
